# CNBC

> > CNBC delivers real-time business news, market analysis, and financial insights covering global markets, economic trends, and corporate developments.

CNBC is a leading business and financial news network providing comprehensive coverage of stock markets, economic policy, investing strategies, and global business developments. The platform features expert analysis, video content, and breaking news from market exchanges including Nasdaq, with insights from Federal Reserve officials, CEOs, and financial analysts.

## Key Topics

- Stock Markets & Trading
- Nasdaq Exchange & IPOs
- Global Economy & Geopolitics
- Federal Reserve & Monetary Policy
- Middle East Conflict & Oil Prices
- European Markets
- Asia-Pacific Investing
- Wealth Management
- Market Analysis & Forecasting
- Corporate Leadership & CEOs
- Financial News & Business Updates
- Exchange Operations
- Investment Strategies
- Economic Indicators
- Geopolitical Risk

## Market Coverage & Analysis

- [Top Videos](https://www.cnbc.com/top-video/): Top business videos featuring Fed officials, CEOs, and market analysis
- [Global Stock Market News and World Indices Coverage](https://www.cnbc.com/world-markets/): Global stock markets, indices, and Asia-Pacific investing trends coverage
- [Nasdaq](https://www.cnbc.com/nasdaq/): Nasdaq stock exchange news, IPOs, and market updates with Adena Friedman

## Global Economy & Geopolitics

- [Global Economy](https://www.cnbc.com/world-economy/): Global economy news covering Iran, South Korea, India, and geopolitical risk
- [Nigeria](https://www.cnbc.com/nigeria/): Nigeria economy, currency crisis, China investment, and Africa business news
